Edit fields. `completed` / `archived` take booleans; `description` / `due_at` can be cleared with null.

Contributors may only send `completed` (and `version`); every other field requires editor.
Send the `version` you loaded to get a 409 instead of overwriting a change made since.

get.description:
What changed on any of your boards after entry `since`, oldest first.

Built for polling (e.g. an agent checking in every few minutes): keep `next_since` and send it
back next time. Entries appear a few seconds after they happen, so that one committed late is
never skipped.

For Docker/Coolify healthchecks: healthy only if the database answers too.

A deploy whose app starts but can't reach its database is a failed deploy; saying "healthy"
there would let it replace a working version.
